dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: We Druzhna are not at liberty to scramble this way and that. The Commission, which spends its days traveling across Snezhnaya to maintain the Kresnik's Torches, is more nimble in this regard...

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: It does strike me as somewhat odd... It sometimes feels like they know something about the Shadow Realm...

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: But so long as they detect the Realms in time, that's good enough for me.
